statements.label: supported
statements.text: Gene expression and alternative splicing analyses were run on 44 osteosarcoma patients to build a genome-wide co-expression network of RNA-binding proteins, alternative splicing events and alternatively spliced genes.
statements.evidence: gene expression and AS analyses were performed on 44 osteosarcoma patients to create a genome-wide co-expression network of RNA-binding proteins (RBPs), AS events, and AS genes
statements.note: The abstract states the analyses covered 44 osteosarcoma patients and produced a co-expression network of RBPs, AS events and AS genes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Higher KPNA2 expression went together with poorer survival of osteosarcoma patients.
statements.evidence: Karyopherin Subunit Alpha 2 (KPNA2) negatively correlated with patient survival.
statements.note: A negative correlation between KPNA2 and patient survival means more KPNA2, shorter survival.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Pharmacological inhibition of KPNA2 prolonged survival in a mouse model of osteosarcoma.
statements.evidence: KPNA2/YBX1/DDX3X axis might be potential targets for inhibiting disease progression and improving OS patient survival.
statements.note: The axis is only proposed as a potential target; no inhibitor treatment or animal survival experiment is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: YBX1 lowers DDX3X protein by promoting intron retention in the DDX3X transcript and speeding its degradation through nonsense-mediated decay.
statements.evidence: YBX1 accelerates the degradation of the ATP-dependent RNA helicase DDX3X (DDX3X) through the nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) pathway to promote intron retention of the DDX3X gene, thus reducing DDX3X protein levels
statements.note: The abstract describes YBX1 driving NMD-mediated degradation and intron retention of DDX3X, which reduces DDX3X protein.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The 15-nucleotide motif also occurs in the 3'UTRs of other paraspeckle target mRNAs identified in the rat pituitary cell line.
statements.evidence: By developing a candidate gene strategy, we selected a paraspeckle target gene, namely calreticulin mRNA, and we searched for other potential RNA recruitment elements in its 3'UTR
statements.note: Only the calreticulin 3'UTR was examined; whether the motif is present in other target mRNAs is not reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In the rat pituitary cell line, the previously identified paraspeckle target RNAs lacked inverted repeated SINEs in their 3'UTRs.
statements.evidence: we did not find, however, inverted repeated SINEs, the rat equivalent of primate IRAlus in 3'UTR of these RNAs
statements.note: The abstract reports that the rat equivalent of IRAlus was absent from the 3'UTRs of the paraspeckle target RNAs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mass spectrometry showed that six of the proteins binding the 15-nucleotide sequence are paraspeckle proteins.
statements.evidence: As shown by mass spectrometry analysis, 6 proteins bound to the 15-nucleotide sequence are paraspeckle proteins
statements.note: The abstract gives the count directly: 6 proteins bound to the motif are paraspeckle proteins.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: A tandemly repeated 15-nucleotide sequence with a C-rich stretch upstream in the calreticulin 3'UTR contributes to nuclear retention by paraspeckles.
statements.evidence: We found a 15-nucleotide sequence surrounded in 5' by a C-rich sequence, which is present as a tandem repeat in the 3'UTR of this mRNA and which is involved in the nuclear retention by paraspeckles.
statements.note: This restates the motif's described features: 15 nt, C-rich sequence in 5', tandem repeat, involved in nuclear retention.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Combined bulk and single-cell RNA-seq showed PCBP2 is downregulated in testicular tissue from men with non-obstructive azoospermia.
statements.evidence: we identified and validated PCBP2 downregulation in testicular tissues from patients with non-obstructive azoospermia (NOA) by integrating bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets
statements.note: The abstract reports PCBP2 downregulation in NOA testes identified by integrating bulk and scRNA-seq data.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Germline Pcbp2 knockout mice had fewer mid-pachytene spermatocytes and showed an arrest at step 9 of spermiogenesis.
statements.evidence: we observed a reduction in mid-pachytene spermatocytes and a distinct developmental arrest at step 9 of spermiogenesis
statements.note: Both the reduced mid-pachytene population and the step 9 arrest are stated explicitly.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: PCBP2 recruits hnRNPU and DDX5 to meiosis transcripts such as Spo11, Tdrd5 and Brme1 and to spermiogenesis transcripts including Eif4g3, Piwil1 and Dlec1.
statements.evidence: PCBP2 recruits hnRNPU and DDX5 to key transcripts related to meiosis (Spo11, Tdrd5 and Brme1) and spermiogenesis (Eif4g3, Piwil1 and Dlec1)
statements.note: The recruitment of hnRNPU and DDX5 to the named meiosis and spermiogenesis transcripts is the mechanism the abstract reports.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Re-expressing PCBP2 in Pcbp2-deficient germ cells restored normal spermiogenesis.
statements.evidence: To investigate its function, we generated mice with a germline-specific ablation of Pcbp2. These mice exhibited delayed meiotic prophase and impaired spermiogenesis.
statements.note: Only the loss-of-function phenotype is described; no rescue or re-expression experiment is mentioned.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Treating porcine fetal fibroblasts with 10 mmol/L cycloleucine for 48 h lowered METTL3, WTAP, YTHDC1 and YTHDF2 expression and raised FTO expression.
statements.evidence: treatment of PFFs with 10 mmol/L CL for 48 h significantly decreased the expression of METTL3, WTAP, YTHDC1, and YTHDF2, increased the expression of the demethylase FTO, and reduced m6A levels
statements.note: Dose, duration, the decreased writers and readers, and the increased demethylase FTO are all given in this sentence.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Embryo transfer of clones from CL-treated donor cells produced more live piglets than transfer of control clones.
statements.evidence: which may contribute to improved in vitro development of porcine cloned embryos
statements.note: Development was assessed in vitro up to the blastocyst stage; embryo transfer and live births are not reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Cloned embryos made from CL-treated donor fibroblasts reached the blastocyst stage at a significantly higher rate.
statements.evidence: Using CL-treated PFFs as donor cells, the blastocyst rate of cloned embryos was significantly increased.
statements.note: The abstract states the blastocyst rate increased significantly with CL-treated donor cells.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: By immunofluorescence, 2- to 8-cell embryos from the CL-treated group had lower m6A and H3K9me3 levels than controls.
statements.evidence: Immunofluorescence analysis revealed lower m6A and H3K9me3 levels in the CL-treated group than in the control group during the 2-8-cell stages.
statements.note: The comparison with controls at the 2-8-cell stages is stated directly for both m6A and H3K9me3.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Applied to four human cell lines, the framework shrank candidate sORF sets from thousands or millions to a small number of concordant loci.
statements.evidence: the framework produces dramatically smaller and more reliable candidate sets, reducing thousands to millions of predicted sORFs down to a small number of high confidence concordant loci
statements.note: The reduction from thousands-to-millions of predictions down to a small concordant set is the headline benchmarking result.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The pseudogene sORF RPL26P19 was found reproducibly in HeLa cells, whereas existing tools missed it or called it inconsistently.
statements.evidence: the pseudogene encoded sORF RPL26P19 was detected consistently in HeLa cells but missed or inconsistently identified by existing tools
statements.note: Consistent detection by the framework versus missed or inconsistent calls by other tools is stated for RPL26P19.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: A sORF from pseudogene UBE3AP2 was seen only in normal primary cell types and was absent from HeLa.
statements.evidence: a separate pseudogene sORF from UBE3AP2 was observed specifically in normal primary cell types and absent in HeLa
statements.note: The UBE3AP2 candidate's restriction to normal primary cells and absence in HeLa is reported verbatim.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: RPL26P19 was translated at a higher level in proliferating HeLa cells than in cell-cycle-arrested cells.
statements.evidence: Across HeLa cell cycle conditions, a limited set of unique concordant sORFs was identified spanning multiple transcript classes
statements.note: sORFs were catalogued across cell cycle conditions, but no comparison of RPL26P19 translation between conditions is given.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Knocking down CDH3 in melanoma cell lines reduced their invasive capacity.
statements.evidence: Key gene expression levels were evaluated using reverse transcription-quantitative PCR and immunohistochemistry.
statements.note: The wet-lab work measured expression only; no knockdown or invasion assay is described.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Of 94 differentially expressed metastasis-related mRNAs, 45 showed significant associations with m6A regulators.
statements.evidence: A total of 94 metastasis-related mRNAs were identified as differentially expressed, of which 45 demonstrated significant associations with m6A regulators.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The ceRNA network built around CDH3, KRT17, PKP1 and CRABP2 contained 13 long noncoding RNAs and 20 microRNAs.
statements.evidence: A ceRNA network comprising these four mRNAs, 13 long noncoding RNAs, and 20 microRNAs was constructed.
statements.note: The network composition is stated: four mRNAs, 13 lncRNAs, 20 miRNAs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The four core genes were expressed at higher levels in tumor than in adjacent normal tissue and were associated with worse overall survival.
statements.evidence: These core genes demonstrated significantly higher expression levels in tumor tissues compared with in adjacent normal tissues, were associated with a worse overall survival

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Overexpressing hsa_piR_018849 increased osteosarcoma cell proliferation, migration and invasion and decreased apoptosis.
statements.evidence: Overexpression of hsa_piR_018849 promoted the proliferation, migration, and invasion of osteosarcoma cells while inhibiting apoptosis.
statements.note: The abstract lists increased proliferation, migration and invasion and inhibited apoptosis upon overexpression.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: hsa_piR_018849 also promoted proliferation of osteosarcoma cells in vivo.
statements.evidence: Hsa_piR_018849 facilitated the proliferation of osteosarcoma cells in vivo.
statements.note: In vivo proliferation is reported in addition to the cell culture results.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Restoring CCN5 expression reversed the growth-promoting effect of hsa_piR_018849 on osteosarcoma cells.
statements.evidence: PiRNA hsa_piR_018849 regulates the function of osteosarcoma cells by targeting and inhibiting the expression of CCN5.

statements.text: hsa_piR_018849 lowered CCN5 levels by binding to the coding sequence of CCN5 mRNA and reducing its stability.

statements.note: Reduced CCN5 expression and the CDS-binding, stability-reducing mechanism are both stated.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The new GWAS meta-analysis for MASLD included 16,532 cases and 1,240,188 controls.
statements.evidence: we conducted a new GWAS meta-analysis including 16,532 cases and 1,240,188 controls
statements.note: Case and control numbers are given directly in the abstract.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Silencing TRIB1AL in mouse liver reduced hepatic fat accumulation.
statements.evidence: These results open the door to liver-targeted therapeutics silencing of the non-coding genome for the prevention and treatment of MASLD and cardiometabolic diseases.
statements.note: Silencing is proposed as a future therapeutic direction; no intervention experiment in animals or cells is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The lead variant at TRIB1AL showed no link with expression of the neighbouring protein-coding gene TRIB1.
statements.evidence: The lead genetic variant was not linked with expression levels of the nearby protein-coding gene TRIB1 (Tribbles Pseudokinase 1).
statements.note: The abstract explicitly reports no association between the lead variant and TRIB1 expression.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Lower hepatic TRIB1AL expression was associated with less liver fat, lower plasma lipoprotein lipids, reduced atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease risk and longer lifespan.
statements.evidence: lower liver-expressed TRIB1AL as being associated with reduced liver fat accumulation, lower plasma lipoprotein-lipid levels, decreased atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease risk, and increased human lifespan

statements.label: supported
statements.text: ADAR1p110 interacts with core spliceosome components as well as auxiliary splicing regulators.

statements.note: The proteomic analysis of interactors found spliceosome components and auxiliary regulators bound to ADAR1p110.

statements.label: supported

statements.note: The abstract states that most splicing alterations are editing-independent and often RNA-binding-independent.

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Activated CD4+ memory T cells were more abundant in breast cancer samples.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Silencing LINC00200 in breast cancer cells raised miR-20b-5p and lowered HMGB3 expression.
statements.evidence: Although this axis holds promise as a novel prognostic marker, further functional studies and assessment of diagnostic utility are warranted.

statements.text: qRT-PCR showed higher LINC00200 and HMGB3 in breast cancer cells, while miR-20b-5p was lower in MCF-7 but higher in BT549 and MDA-MB-231.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Short-term memory was unaffected in TraxE126A mice.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The E126A point mutation in Trax eliminates the RNase activity of the Translin/Trax complex.

statements.text: In TraxE126A hippocampus, mRNA-level gene expression was substantially reduced and levels of miRNAs and tsRNAs were altered.

statements.label: supported

statements.evidence: enables analysis of differential expression, differential alternative splicing, differential transcript usage, and gene ontology-based functional enrichment for all three

statements.evidence: Isoform-level analyses revealed stronger prognostic associations than gene-level parameter, including for IGF2BP2-202, PUF60-202, and GLUL-203

statements.evidence: Only three significant SNPs were located within clock genes themselves, all in Clk, whereas most associations represented trans-eQTLs in genes with diverse molecular functions
